• The Death Benefit Type selection you make will determine the stages that your benefit records go through for processing and this selection cannot be undone. Below is an explanation on what each selection means:


    • Member is Retired and nominates a Survivor | Select: -Survivor Payments - Post Retirement Death
    • Member is Not-Retired and nominates a Survivor | Select: -Survivor Payments - Pre Retirement Death
    • Member is Retired and nominates a Designee | Select: -Estate Payments - Post Retirement Death
    • Member is Not Retired and nominates a Designee | Select: -Estate Payments - Pre Retirement Death
